# BBB Library

> The digital archive of the Broke Bibliophiles of Bangalore book club: the meetups held, the books and other media discussed, and the readers who took part.

## Pages
- [Library Room](https://bbbdemo.vercel.app/library-room): browse the books the club has discussed
- [Meetups](https://bbbdemo.vercel.app/meetups): every meetup, with its date, venue and what was discussed
- [Members](https://bbbdemo.vercel.app/members): readers and their reading history (members who asked to be hidden are not listed)
- [Privacy](https://bbbdemo.vercel.app/privacy): what data this site holds and why

## Notes
- This is a demo deployment. Data is read-only for visitors. Counts shown on the site come from the live database.
